summary: Independent controller review: the ledger case is bound to the existing WorkItem loop-state use case and gives an implementation-independent, compiled-CLI oracle for the approved public causal_lifecycle projection. It checks the v1 shape, WI drift, deterministic fresh-process hydration, and a real persisted legacy loop-state input. Detailed EC/TD/CB evidence invalidation and rebind flows remain the explicitly named Rust reducer invariants until their later public leaves exist.
